assets.desktop:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Create a new premium photographic website background for Pardus Luxury Escapes. Ultra-wide 2.4:1 landscape, highest native quality. This must have the visual character of real wildlife and location photographs carefully combined by an expert travel-magazine retoucher.

The main subject is a REALISTIC adult African leopard walking slowly to the right across a weathered pale limestone ledge, photographed full-body at the animal's eye level. Show the whole tail, four anatomically correct legs and paws, and whole head. It occupies only the right third of the image, approximately x60–91%, y38–73%. The camera is pulled back; plenty of air around the animal. A calm candid wildlife photograph, 135mm lens, natural soft light. The leopard has a lean natural build, irregular organic dark-brown rosettes on muted tawny fur, fine soft coat hairs, visible natural variation and slight disarray in the coat, realistic small eyes and whiskers, relaxed face and ears. Fur looks matte and tactile, subtle real camera detail, natural colour. Paws firmly grounded with believable delicate shadows.

The ledge has one gently curved outer edge that quietly suggests the curve of the Earth, rather than a literal miniature globe. Below and behind it, a sophisticated soft photographic travel montage blends a turquoise Indian Ocean coast with just a few overwater villas, a very distant hazy Dubai skyline including Burj Khalifa, and a small distant stretch of East African acacia savannah. The locations share the same gentle daylight and dissolve naturally through pale atmospheric mist. The result must feel like a luxury travel editorial photograph, with large simple masses and optical depth, not a detailed fantasy diorama. The stone foreground and leopard remain the primary natural photographic anchors. Destinations are secondary and restrained.

The entire left 48% is spacious, softly lit pale ivory-grey sky and very faint distant coastal haze, suitable for dark website headline text added later. Keep top 20% quiet for a navigation bar. Keep the subject away from these text areas. Smooth tonal transitions, natural restrained colours, real subtle photographic texture, light airy mood, soft late-morning diffuse daylight and neutral white balance. Photographic detail should be natural and softly resolved rather than digitally sharpened.

Do not render any text, logo, watermark or UI. No plastic CGI surfaces, doll-like animals, glistening fur, thick black uniform rosettes, hyper-detailed texture, surreal oversaturation, glowing outlines, heavy HDR, crunchy edges, golden-hour orange, dramatic sky or paper globe panels. The final image should be calm, striking and convincingly photographic while retaining the leopard-and-world-travel concept.
assets.mobile:
Use case: compositing.
Asset type: mobile portrait website hero background for Pardus Luxury Escapes.
Primary request: adapt the provided landscape background into a beautifully composed 9:16 PORTRAIT mobile companion image. Recompose the scene for portrait; preserve the same photographic character, leopard, locations, light and restrained colours. Highest available native image quality.

Input image 1: approved visual reference and source scene to adapt. Preserve its relaxed full-body right-facing African leopard, pale natural limestone foreground, gently lit Indian Ocean coast with a few overwater villas, very distant Dubai skyline/Burj Khalifa, and subtle East African acacia savannah. This is a matching mobile background, without lettering or UI.

MOBILE COMPOSITION:
Portrait canvas 9 wide by 16 high. The upper 48–52% must be calm, pale warm ivory-grey sky with extremely soft distant haze, clean enough for dark navigation, a large three-line headline and buttons to be added separately in HTML. Keep these areas free from the leopard, skyline, rock and other high-contrast objects. Give the top edge ample clear sky.
Place the ENTIRE leopard across the lower third, approximately x=10–92%, y=64–80%, walking right on the pale limestone ledge. The leopard is prominent and fully legible at phone size while leaving breathing room at both sides. All four paws, full tail, ears and muzzle must be inside the image. Keep its side profile and natural anatomy, coat pattern, matte fine fur, calm expression and contact shadows consistent with the source.
Behind the leopard, arrange the travel vista in one coherent photographic landscape: a small softened Dubai skyline near the right centre at y=51–65%, muted turquoise sea and a few restrained timber overwater villas toward the lower-left, distant acacia savannah toward the right. The weathered limestone ledge supports the animal at about y=80% and continues to the bottom edge. Keep the broad gentle curvature of the ledge, smooth atmospheric depth, and simple uncluttered masses.

PHOTOGRAPHIC FINISH:
Same soft natural daylight and neutral white balance as the reference. Convincing wildlife photograph texture, organically irregular rosettes, smooth tonal transitions, real stone and water, restrained contrast and saturation. No oversharpening or artificial plastic sheen. Natural photography composite prepared by a luxury travel magazine retoucher, quiet and spacious.

Constraints: adapt only composition/aspect ratio and necessary background extension. Keep the subject, direction, photographic style and destination concept consistent. No cropped animal, second leopard, extra legs, new dramatic lighting, globe/atlas panels, saturated orange, HDR glow, painted foliage, CGI textures, decorative symbols, text, logo, phone frame, watermark, or website mockup. Render the background image itself only.
assets.coast:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: clean photographic background for section two of a premium travel website, ultra-wide landscape 2.4:1.
Reference image 1 is a palette, natural-light and landscape-continuity reference ONLY. The new scene is the continuation below this hero as a visitor scrolls: pale limestone and sand easing into an Indian Ocean cove. Do not include a leopard in this second image.

Create an elevated oblique coastal photograph of a quiet Indian Ocean bay: pale warm ivory limestone and soft sand across the upper-left half, a gently curving unspoilt shore sweeping toward the lower right, a few understated palms far to the right, natural muted turquoise water becoming deep slate blue in the lower third. Photographic textures in the stone, delicate shallow-water ripples, a soft restrained shoreline. Relaxed luxury travel-magazine image with natural daylight, neutral colours and gentle atmospheric depth. Simple, spacious, refined; no artificial CGI shine or oversharpening.

Composition specifically for continuous website art direction: the whole upper 18% is very pale ivory stone/sand with extremely soft detail so its edge can fade seamlessly from the previous hero's pale foreground. Left 55% of the upper/middle area stays calm and light for a live navy heading. The interesting coast and turquoise lagoon lie predominantly on the right and lower portions. The bottom edge is mostly dark slate-blue sea and soft shadow, easy to fade into a midnight navy destination-card section. One coherent location photograph, restrained foliage, fine natural detail, smooth tonal transitions. No horizon or dramatic sky is needed. Maximum available image quality.

Do not include buildings, models, people, animals, lettering, maps, borders, logos, watermarks, interface elements, obvious photo montage seams, tropical oversaturation, orange sunset, glowing water, or dramatic high contrast. This is a real-looking coastal background, not a website mockup.
